settings.heading: Three steps to your first order

settings.question: Who can partner with Tulia?
settings.answer: Salons, spas, skin and aesthetic clinics, freelance beauticians and makeup artists, retail stockists and pharmacies, hotels, resorts & boutique gifting buyers and dealers and distributors.

settings.question: What is the minimum order?
settings.answer: Our opening orders start at 50 units, designed to scale with your business size and needs.

settings.question: What margins do partners earn?
settings.answer: Partners earn between 35% to 50% margins depending on order volumes and partnership tiers.

settings.question: Can I order more than 100 units or reorder regularly?
settings.answer: Yes! We support repeat orders, multi-location rollouts, and custom wholesale terms.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24-48 hours with standard courier delivery across India.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: We support secure payments via UPI, bank transfer, cards, and net banking.

settings.question: Are the products suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes, all Tulia formulations are dermatologically tested, patch-tested, and formulated for sensitive skin and Indian climate.
